ordinary.check: Ask about actual staffing and process knowledge

return_cut.statement: I may favor redesign because it gives my analysis a larger role
return_cut.defeater: When a product-lead-owned comparison finds instruction sufficient, I recommend keeping instruction and closing this analysis

evidence.statement: Participant says the interpretation is wrong

readings.claim: They secretly want to remain indispensable

defeat_test.method: Ask what a supported handoff requires
defeat_test.observation: They delegate once staffing is available

outcome.action: Ask them to challenge their need to be indispensable
outcome.reason: Their disagreement is treated as confirmation
outcome.stop_rule: Reconsider if instruction alone performs as well
